name: srvname-case-insensitive-service-valid
description: RFC 4985 §2: 'The Service is case insensitive.' A permittedSubtrees SRVName constraint of _mail must therefore be satisfied by an SRVName SAN whose service component differs only in letter case (_MAIL.example.com).
notes: A strict octet-for-octet matcher would reject this chain. A conforming RFC 4985 validator must accept it; that asymmetry is the differential signal.
